edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

editorial_notes: Read in full against the Government Printer PDF (data/legal-sources/library/amendments/incoming/20-2005-tea-and-rubber-estate-control-of-fragmentation-act-amendment.pdf, 9 pp., text layer, certified 22nd July 2005): the same 12 sections, the same operations and the same inserted text; the HTML page carries no subscription banner. The RUBRIK's 'title does not match this statute' flag on this file is a false positive: the HTML title 'Tea And Rubber Estates (Control Of Fragmentation) (Amendment)' and the long title 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE TEA AND RUBBER ESTATES (CONTROL OF FRAGMENTATION) ACT, NO. 2 OF 1958' name this statute.
Section 9 refers to section 23A, the section it inserts into the principal enactment; the validator's 'beyond last section 12' warning is that reference, not a defect.

The Act names the renamed Board inconsistently: 'Tea, Rubber and Coconut Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Board' in section 3(1)(b) and 'Tea, Rubber and Coconut (Control of Fragmentation) Board' in section 3(2) and the marginal note (printed 'Contorl').

Government Printer parse (parse_amendment_pdf.py, regenerated output at data/processed/canonical-amendments/20-2005.json) folded sections 7 and 9 into section 12 and was not accepted; this HTML-derived tree stays the accepted one.

provision.heading: Prohibition of approval of blocking out plans by certain officers of local authorities without a certificate from the Board.
provision.raw_text: 23A (1) No officer of a local authority shall approve a blocking out plan of any land which is a tea estate, a rubber estate or a coconut estate, as the case may be, within the meaning of the Act, unless a certificate of consent under section 14 of the Act has been issued by the Board relating to such estate.

body.heading: Existing Board to continue until the constitution of new Board.
body.raw_text: 12.
